patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I slipped on the wet floor and caught myself on my hand. Now my wrist is swollen and bent a bit funny, and it really hurts to move. My fingers are fine though.
presentation.triageNote: 63-year-old female who fell onto an outstretched hand. Her wrist is swollen and dorsally angulated with a dinner-fork appearance; movement is painful, while finger movement, sensation, and distal circulation remain intact.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 3 is appropriate because a displaced wrist fracture with visible angulation is expected to require multiple resources including imaging, analgesia, and reduction.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This older adult has a visibly displaced distal-forearm injury after a fall, with intact distal neurovascular function.
clinical.acuityReason: The dinner-fork deformity makes a displaced fracture likely; current circulation and sensation are reassuring but do not remove the need for reduction planning.
keyFindings: Intact finger movement, sensation, and circulation
teachingPoints: Neurovascular status must be documented before and after splinting or reduction.
The reason for an older adult's fall and bone-health risk should also be assessed.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Imaging, analgesia, and reduction would be followed by immobilization and orthopedic follow-up or operative planning.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, cradling a deformed, swollen wrist
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 63-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: cradling a swollen, bent wrist against her body. Expression: pained but stoic. Clearly visible: a visibly deformed, swollen wrist. No text, no logos.
